upstream.revisionPolicy: Evaluation is pinned to this exact commit. The parent PP+TP inference wave and later Transformers main commits do not transfer qualification to this training topology.

materialChanges: Masks sentinel-tail rows after each expert-parallel grouped GEMM to stop uninitialized values from propagating NaN or Inf gradients through MoE training.
All-reduce-sums router-score gradients before the non-local expert mask so router and upstream non-expert parameters receive remote-expert gradient contributions.
Routes expert parallelism through Trainer and enables Expert Parallelism with FSDP2 on a named two-dimensional fsdp/tp device mesh.
Uses mesh-specific gradient norm reduction and optimizer parameter groups because fused or foreach optimizers cannot span parameters living on different device meshes.

Gathers the sharded model state through save_pretrained collectively, while explicitly refusing optimizer-checkpoint resume for models sharded at load time and rejecting pipeline parallelism combined with tp/fsdp.

upstreamReportedEvidence.label: UPSTREAM_REPORTED_NOT_SZL_MEASURED
upstreamReportedEvidence.gradientReference: OLMoE-1B-7B fp32 one-batch comparison reported 3/179 matching parameters before the router-gradient fix and 179/179 after it, max relative error 2.7e-5.
upstreamReportedEvidence.optimizerTiming: Qwen3-30B-A3B tp=4 x fsdp=2 reported 189 ms/step for per-parameter stepping versus 41 ms fused per mesh group.

acceptance: Pin exact Transformers source 415e6d2f596ef2bd44fdee4261799200a7fc02bf, torch and accelerate versions, CUDA driver and NCCL stack, model and tokenizer revisions, hardware topology, world size, seeds and exact launch command.
Use a fixed synthetic MoE fixture and or a fixed public non-secret small MoE checkpoint first; do not download or rehost weights merely for inventory.
Establish single-device and Expert-Parallel-only reference losses and gradients before FSDP2 plus EP; compare router, non-expert and expert parameter gradients with declared tolerances.
Prove no NaN or Inf gradient propagation across repeated optimizer steps and directly exercise grouped-GEMM sentinel-tail masking rather than inferring correctness from loss alone.
Prove the named fsdp/tp mesh shape, rank ownership, expert routing and dispatch, router-score gradient all-reduce semantics and per-mesh total-gradient-norm calculation.
Verify Trainer integration, mesh-specific optimizer parameter groups and deterministic batch partitioning; reject pipeline-parallel composition with tp/fsdp exactly as the upstream contract requires.
Exercise collective save_pretrained state-dict gather and exact reload from the admitted topology; keep optimizer checkpoint resume unsupported where upstream refuses it.
Exercise rank loss, collective timeout, malformed mesh, OOM, cancellation and rollback to the previous admitted training path with failure receipts.

Correctness precedes performance. Only after loss, gradient and save-reload gates pass may same-hardware step latency, throughput and peak memory be compared with EP-only and the current admitted SZL training baseline.
Keep model or adapter publication, production training, product routing, model qualification and automatic promotion false unless separate normal controls prove them.
